repository_purpose: AgentCo exists to evolve into progressively more general intelligence by operating as an evidence-governed, calibration-driven AI civilization that learns continuously, improves itself safely, and expands its capability across domains over time.

requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.who_needs_it: Operators and users invoking production agents
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.trigger: Backend route, TS identity, or agent manifest entrypoint invokes an active agent
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.input_output: Governed action request -> audited success/failure with evidence and spend context
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.success_criteria: Unauthorized execution rejected; allowed execution audited; undeclared tools blocked
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.failure_expectations: Failures are finalized and audit-chained; no direct ledger writes

requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.who_needs_it: Governance, evaluation, learning, experiment, and operator audit flows
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.trigger: Any governed action or protocol writer appends decision_log
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.input_output: Audit event + attempt_id -> idempotent decision_log row with hash-chain link
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.success_criteria: Versioned rows reject legacy hashes, missing post-cutoff versions, and tampered versions
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.failure_expectations: Write or ACK failures fail closed unless retry confirms the same attempt_id row
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.production_evidence: make release-gate runs audit-chain-cross-writer.test.ts when DB is available

requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.who_needs_it: Owners deciding whether outputs are correct, supported, and calibrated
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.input_output: Agent output + evidence + confidence -> immutable evaluation record and metrics
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.success_criteria: Unsupported high-confidence and tampered evidence fail; calibration metrics reproduce

requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.trigger: A learning artifact is proposed, evaluated, approved, promoted, or rolled back
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.input_output: Artifact + evaluation evidence + approval -> staged promotion or rejection
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.success_criteria: Phase 10 evidence required; self-approval rejected; rollback recovers previous version
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.failure_expectations: Regressions or tampered evidence block promotion and are audited

requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.trigger: Experiment proposal submitted through governed experiment service
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.input_output: Hypothesis + scope + budgets + evidence -> audited experiment result and promotion recommendation
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.success_criteria: Sandbox-only, resource-bounded, no production mutation, no self-promotion
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.failure_expectations: Scope escape, budget overrun, unauthorized tools, and tampered evidence fail durably

requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.input_output: Versioned images + secrets + values -> backend, frontend, migration, and outbox workloads
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.success_criteria: Health probes target real endpoints; migrations run once; frontend/API services route correctly
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.failure_expectations: Missing mandatory secrets fail pod/job startup rather than silently selecting fake adapters
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.production_evidence: Helm render remains externally unverified where helm binary is unavailable

requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.trigger: Frontend request to backend API dependency
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.input_output: User/session or server-side proxy request -> authorized backend response
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.success_criteria: Privileged API keys never appear in browser bundle; protected routes reject missing credentials
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.failure_expectations: Invalid auth returns sanitized 401/403; service keys remain server-side
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.production_evidence: make release-gate includes frontend auth smoke where services are available

requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.who_needs_it: Operators responding to database, event, deployment, or rollback failure
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.trigger: Backup, restore, release, rollback, or incident procedure
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.success_criteria: Commands exist, avoid secrets in source, and document external prerequisites
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.failure_expectations: Unavailable external infrastructure is reported as unverified, not success
requirements_to_behaviour_matrix.production_evidence: Live cluster restore remains externally unverified without cluster/credentials

claim_to_evidence_matrix.claim: AgentCo exists to evolve into progressively more general intelligence by operating as an evidence-governed, calibration-driven AI civilization that learns continuously, improves itself safely, and expands its capability across domains over time.
claim_to_evidence_matrix.implementation_evidence: Active-agent conformance, evaluation/calibration, controlled-learning, and self-improvement reports
claim_to_evidence_matrix.runtime_entrypoint: make release-gate plus production backend/Helm deployment
claim_to_evidence_matrix.limitation: General intelligence and continuous improvement are roadmap intent; verified behavior is bounded governed execution and evaluated promotion controls.

claim_to_evidence_matrix.claim: A stranger can run the credibility gate.
claim_to_evidence_matrix.limitation: DB/Kafka-backed parts are capability-probed or require local services.

claim_to_evidence_matrix.implementation_evidence: Backend, frontend, service, ingress, migration, outbox worker templates
claim_to_evidence_matrix.limitation: Helm binary/cluster not available in this environment for render/apply proof.

claim_to_evidence_matrix.claim: Browser does not receive privileged service API key.
claim_to_evidence_matrix.implementation_evidence: Frontend proxy uses server-side AGENTCO_API_KEY; Helm frontend template avoids NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENTCO_API_KEY
claim_to_evidence_matrix.limitation: Full deployed browser bundle scan depends on production build artifact.

finding_completeness_ledger.file_audit_note: All tracked files are inventoried. Line-level review is intentionally not marked complete by this generated control ledger.

independent_post_remediation_reaudit.method: Run release gate and focused contract tests after remediation.
Review git diff for removed assertions, new skips, xfails, or force exits.
Compare README/Helm/Makefile commands to actual targets and tests.
Search for TODO/FIXME/stub/mock/fallback and classify remaining hits.
Re-run original reproduction checks and ensure new tests fail on the old behavior.
